# hackthebox

## recon-setup
```
recon-setup <machine_name> -v <vpn_path> -s <session_path|~/htb/machines> -a -i <ip>
```

## cradle_gen.py
```
cradle_gen.py <lhost> <lport> -l
```

## windows remote flags
```
nxc smb <ip> -u <user|Administrator> <auth> -x 'powershell -e '
```
